scripts.install:all: npm install && python3 -m pip install -r services/api/requirements-dev.txt
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/mobile && python3 -m ruff check services/api scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/mobile && npm run typecheck --workspace @denge-atlasi/api-client && python3 -m mypy services/api/app services/api/scripts
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/mobile -- --runInBand && python3 -m pytest services/api/tests
scripts.contract:check: npm run openapi:generate && npm run api-client:generate && npm run typecheck --workspace @denge-atlasi/api-client
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run contract:check && npm run docs:validate && npm run secrets:check
